item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta21
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.0-beta21

Breaking Changes

  • destinations: Obsidian destination no longer targets daily notes

New Features

  • settings: add Obsidian REST connection test and docs
  • adapters: write via Obsidian REST API with file fallback
  • adapters: add Obsidian Local REST API client
  • settings: add Obsidian Daily Note configuration UI
  • services: list daily note sections for obsidian-daily
  • destinations: register Obsidian Daily Note destination
  • adapters: add Obsidian daily note file write adapter
  • services: resolve Obsidian vault paths and daily note config
  • services: convert moment.js date formats to DateFormatter
  • models: add Obsidian daily note route config fields
  • models: add retriable targetNotFound error code

Bug Fixes

  • destinations: Obsidian destination no longer targets daily notes
  • adapters: drop legacy Obsidian daily-note append path
  • scripts: strip quotes when reading MARKETING_VERSION
  • obsidian-daily: close test race and wire REST test path
  • adapters: invalidate pinned REST sessions, warn when unverified
  • adapters: reject path traversal in Obsidian REST client
  • recovery: exempt user-resolvable failures from retry cap
  • services: mark Obsidian vault locator types nonisolated
  • adapters: tighten Obsidian daily-note adapter test rigor

item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta12
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.0-beta12

New Destinations

  • SideNotes — Full support with folder selection, note picker, and section-aware insertion
  • FiveNotes — All 5 notes supported with section-aware insertion
  • Raycast Notes — Direct file-based integration (currently hidden pending API clarification)

Destination Improvements

  • Tot — Section-aware insertion now supported; content goes exactly where you want it
  • Drafts — Section heading support and UUID-based append/prepend to existing drafts
  • All destinations — Custom prefix/suffix formatting options for captured content

Settings UI

  • Hierarchical note picker for SideNotes with folder grouping
  • Improved formatting options with live item preview
  • Configuration options now show for all capture modes (Create New, Append, Prepend)
  • Mode-aware labels and descriptions throughout

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed blank line spacing consistency in section insertion across all adapters
  • Fixed style prefix and trailing newline handling for append modes
  • Fixed Test button routing for SideNotes

item.description:
What's New in 1.0.0-beta9

New Features

  • Destination-aware location picker — The capture panel now shows location options specific to each destination instead of a hardcoded dropdown.

Bug Fixes

item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta1
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.0-beta1

Initial beta release of Intake — a minimalist macOS menu bar utility for capturing thoughts and routing them anywhere.

Capture

  • Global hotkey — Summon the capture panel instantly from any app
  • Smart panel — Auto-focuses the title field; resizes dynamically
  • Offline queue — Captures auto-retry when connectivity returns

Destinations

  • Built-in adapters — URL scheme, AppleScript, file, and webhook
  • Todoist, Raindrop.io, Pocket, Pinboard — Direct integrations

History & Data

  • Capture log — Browse, filter, export, and delete past captures
  • iCloud sync — Settings sync across your Macs
  • Secure storage — API keys stored in macOS Keychain
